identify_affected_packages.expected_solution: Removing the `initializer` field from the `TSPropertySignature` AST node in `@babel/types` (changed in `packages/babel-types/src/definitions/typescript.ts`, with regenerated artifacts in `packages/babel-types/src/ast-types/generated/index.ts` and `packages/babel-types/src/builders/generated/index.ts`) propagates to two sibling packages in the babel monorepo: (1) `@babel/parser` (`packages/babel-parser`), whose hand-written TypeScript declarations in `packages/babel-parser/src/types.d.ts` re-declare the TS AST shape and must drop the field, and (2) `@babel/generator` (`packages/babel-generator`), whose TypeScript node printer in `packages/babel-generator/src/generators/typescript.ts` previously emitted the initializer expression. PR #16154 in the v7.23.6 release confirms these are the only sibling packages with non-test changes.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify @babel/parser as affected and reference packages/babel-parser/src/types.d.ts
Must identify @babel/generator as affected and reference packages/babel-generator/src/generators/typescript.ts
Must cite the source change in packages/babel-types/src/definitions/typescript.ts

classify_change_impact.expected_solution: The overall change is classified as a **patch** semver bump for the v7.23.6 release. Rationale: removing `initializer` from `TSPropertySignature` is a bug-fix alignment with the TypeScript spec (interface/object-type property signatures cannot have initializers), not a new feature. Per-package classification: `@babel/types` = patch (corrects an invalid type definition), `@babel/parser` = patch (drops a field that was never produced by valid input — only stale fixture-only field), `@babel/generator` = patch (no longer emits an unreachable branch). No public API method signatures change; the field simply disappears from the AST node interface.
evaluation_criteria: Must classify the overall change as `patch` (not minor or major)
Must classify @babel/parser impact as patch and explain that no public API surface changes
Must classify @babel/generator impact as patch with reasoning that emitted output was unreachable for valid inputs
Should note that the change aligns @babel/types with the TypeScript spec rather than introducing new behavior

identify_boundary_violations.expected_solution: Concrete boundary violations — places where code or type definitions still reference the removed `initializer` field — are: (1) `packages/babel-types/src/definitions/typescript.ts` in the `TSPropertySignature` definition's `fields` block (the source-of-truth schema entry that must be deleted); (2) `packages/babel-parser/src/types.d.ts` where the hand-written `TSPropertySignature` interface enumerates `initializer?: N.Expression`; (3) `packages/babel-generator/src/generators/typescript.ts` inside the `TSPropertySignature` printer function which emits ` = ` followed by the initializer; (4) `packages/babel-types/src/ast-types/generated/index.ts` and `packages/babel-types/src/builders/generated/index.ts`, both regenerated from the definitions file and therefore carry the field through builder signatures and node-type interfaces until regeneration; (5) parser test fixture `packages/babel-parser/test/fixtures/typescript/interface/property-initializer/input.ts` plus its `options.json`, which exercise a now-impossible AST and must be updated or removed.
evaluation_criteria: Must cite packages/babel-types/src/definitions/typescript.ts as the schema-of-record violation
Must cite packages/babel-parser/src/types.d.ts where the field is re-declared in TS
Must cite packages/babel-generator/src/generators/typescript.ts where the field is consumed during printing
Should mention the generated barrels packages/babel-types/src/ast-types/generated/index.ts or packages/babel-types/src/builders/generated/index.ts
Should mention that test fixtures under packages/babel-parser/test/fixtures/typescript/interface/property-initializer/ are also affected
